fact_text: The budget projects a primary surplus of about 2% of GDP, which the analyst names as the most important number for the IMF programme and for macro stability.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The IMF primary surplus target for FY25 is expected at about 1.5% of GDP, and the analyst views primary surplus as the number one determinant of stock market performance once the IMF agreement firms up.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The budget tax target of about PKR 13,000 billion looked hard to reach; the analyst estimated collection near 9,200 billion, or about 11,000 billion with growth and inflation, and expected a mini-budget.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The budget leaves a buffer of roughly 0.5-0.6% of GDP, about PKR 600 billion, against the IMF primary surplus target, and the development budget (PSDP) can be trimmed if tax collection falls short because allocations are often underspent.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Capital gains tax on listed equity is a flat 15% regardless of holding period, but it applies only to shares bought after 1 July 2024.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst expects the capital gains change to have little effect on long-term investors, who hold for the long run regardless of tax, while short-term traders keep trading.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The budget made no change to the dividend tax rate.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The tax rate on fixed-income mutual funds was raised from 15% to 25% in the budget.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: As interest rates fall gradually, demand tends to recover for autos, cement and white goods, because cheaper credit supports purchases of cars, homes and appliances.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The budget raised the sales tax on locally made hybrid cars to 25%, which narrows the price gap between hybrids and conventional cars.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The higher sales tax on hybrids can hit Indus Motor's hybrid Corolla Cross, though the analyst thinks loyal buyers may stay; the budget also raised duty on imported hybrids, a change not yet in the finance act.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The higher hybrid sales tax can also hit Sazgar's Haval hybrids; the analyst's test is to check each carmaker's effective sales tax rate in its latest results, since heavy hybrid sellers will show a lower rate.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Tractors moved from an exempt category to a 10% sales tax; the analyst expects little impact, because tractor sales depend more on farm profits than on tax.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The PSDP development budget of about PKR 1,600 billion is a big positive for cement, if the spending is actually delivered; cement demand follows farm profits and a construction boom.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Federal excise on cement bags was raised and sales tax added, so bag prices are expected to rise, which could slow the recovery in cement volumes.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The industrial electricity package helps cement makers that still buy grid power most, such as Cherat, Gharibwal and Power Cement, while makers on captive power gain less.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Most chemical makers already run on captive power, so a cheaper grid-power package has little effect on them; their profitability depends mainly on international product prices.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The FATA/PATA sales tax exemption for tribal areas has ended under the finance act as described, removing a tax-free source of competition for steel makers; the analyst says an extension is still being sought.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Steel makers mostly operate on grid electricity, so the industrial power package is a clear positive; with the FATA/PATA change, the analyst sees better pricing and possibly higher volumes next year.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Fertilizer makers pay different gas prices, so the gap between companies' gas costs drives profitability more than the budget changes do.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Packaged milk was zero-rated for sales tax, which let packaged milk makers compete with loose milk and expand; losing zero-rating makes them less competitive and weakens their outlook.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The proposed 18% sales tax on packaged milk would hit Nestle Pakistan and other packaged milk makers, but the analyst expects it to be reversed in the final budget.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The fixed 1% income tax regime for exporters was removed, so export profits are now taxed at about 39% including super tax, which cuts after-tax profit for margin-thin exporters.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Illustrative case: an exporter with a 15% pre-tax margin, previously taxed at about 1%, would see after-tax margin fall from about 13% to about 9%, cutting the value of after-tax profit by roughly 25-30%.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: PABC's exports are not hit by the new export tax because it has a 10-year income tax exemption, a protection that the analyst notes as a key point in its favour.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The customs duty on diesel was cut from 11% to 0% in the budget.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The diesel duty cut could almost halve refinery profits, though the analyst thinks it is likely to be reversed in the final budget.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The petroleum levy ceiling was raised to PKR 80 per litre in the budget; the analyst sees limited direct impact on oil marketing companies from this change.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: For oil marketing companies the main pressures are regulated margins and smuggling of Iranian fuel, which keeps eating into their volumes.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Circular debt in the gas chain has been improving since 2023, and the analyst says that if the trend continues, gas-chain companies can perform better.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The budget allocates more than PKR 1,200 billion in power sector subsidies, but the analyst says this is not a reliable gauge of future circular debt, so individual companies' payment timing should be tracked.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Sales tax on mobile phones was raised to 18% from the earlier fixed tax regime, which removes the cost advantage of locally assembled phones over imports.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Airlink's business could be hit by the higher mobile phone sales tax, since the lost advantage of local assembly makes its handsets more expensive relative to imports.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Non-essential pharmaceutical products were deregulated so companies can set their own prices, and sales tax on non-drug pharma products rose to 18%.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The electricity package would help pharma companies too, if it is extended to local industries, though the sector's main theme is the deregulation of non-essential drug prices.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The budget proposes that PIA's tax losses can be carried forward for 10 years, lowering the tax burden on a private buyer who turns the airline profitable.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The tax-loss carry-forward is read as a sign the government is serious about privatising PIA and wants to attract more investors for a better sale price.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Provisioning losses under IFRS 9 were disallowed for tax purposes in the budget, which the analyst judged to have no major impact on banks.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Duty on imported paper products was raised, which could benefit Packages Limited and Century Paper, depending on which exact products are covered.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'BUDGET 2024 - TAX, ANALYSIS, OUTLOOK & IMPACT ON EACH SECTOR OF PSX' (YouTube transcript, undated)
